title: Great couch... for a Hobbit!!!
text: Great couch... for a Hobbit!!!. Since I am a full-sized person and not a Hobbit, this couch is too small for me. I am going to get some different legs for it to see if I can raise it up. The couch is one foot off the ground when assembled. It is absolutely ridiculous. It is also too narrow and too shallow. This was built maybe with the Japanese market in mind instead of the American market.
